dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: A quick snapshot of your finances.
dashboard.syncFromSettings: Sync to Google Sheets from Settings.
dashboard.allTimeTotalsLine: Total Earned: {{earned}} · Total Spent: {{spent}} · Total Saved: {{saved}}
dashboard.fiftyFiftyExpensesInCategory: Expenses in 50/50 category for the selected month, grouped by description. Top 15 shown.
dashboard.myExpensesExcluding: Your expenses (excluding Tasnuva's Purchases, 50/50 & Mortgage) for the selected month. Top 15 shown.
dashboard.tasnuvasOnly: Tasnuva's Purchases only for the selected month. Top 15 shown.
dashboard.totalEarnedVsSpentByMonth: Total earned vs total spent by month.
dashboard.totalsPerMonth: Totals for each month. Current month is highlighted.
dashboard.noDataYet: No data yet. Add income or expenses to see the chart.
dashboard.insightMomUp: Spending is up {{amount}} vs last month.
dashboard.insightMomDown: Spending is down {{amount}} vs last month.
dashboard.insightMomFlat: Spending is flat vs last month.

dashboardDebt.totalDebtRemainingVsPaid: Total debt: remaining vs paid off
dashboardDebt.remainingAndPaidOff: Remaining balance (what you still owe) and total paid off across all debts.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.subtitle: Browse, filter, and edit expense transactions.
transactions.syncConfirmDesc: This will overwrite your spreadsheet with the app's current expenses, income, and totals. Your sheet data will be replaced. This cannot be undone.
transactions.filtersActionsDesc: Filter transactions, add new ones, or perform bulk actions.
transactions.deleteThisDesc: {{date}} {{description}} ({{amount}}) will be removed. This cannot be undone.
transactions.deleteSelectedDesc: {{count}} transaction(s) will be removed. This cannot be undone.
transactions.deleteAllDesc: All {{count}} expense(s) will be removed. This cannot be undone.
transactions.noTransactions: No transactions. Import a CSV or add a manual transaction.

income.title: Income
income.subtitle: Track paychecks, rent, and other income.
income.addIncomeDesc: Paycheck, rent from tenants, bonus, etc.
income.newIncomeDesc: Enter the date, amount, description, and category.
income.editIncomeDesc: Update the date, amount, description, and category.
income.noIncomeEntries: No income entries. Add one above.
income.deleteIncomeDesc: This income entry will be removed. This cannot be undone.

debt.title: Debt
debt.subtitle: Track loans and debt payments.
debt.addDebtDesc: Track a loan or debt (e.g. car loan, credit card). Then record payments to see the balance go down.
debt.newDebtDesc: Enter the debt name and initial amount owed.
debt.debtsDesc: Current balance = initial amount minus payments. Make payments to track progress.
debt.name: Name
debt.noDebtsYet: No debts yet. Add one above.
debt.makePaymentDesc: Record a payment toward this debt. Balance will update automatically.
debt.recurringPaymentDesc: This amount is subtracted from the debt balance (for display) on a schedule. Bi-weekly = every 14 days from first payment date. Monthly = on the chosen day each month.
debt.deleteDebtDesc: This will permanently remove the debt and all its payment history. This cannot be undone.
debt.removePaymentDesc: Payment of {{amount}} on {{date}} will be removed. This cannot be undone.

mortgage.title: Mortgage
mortgage.subtitle: Record mortgage payments (excluded from Transactions list).
mortgage.mortgagePaymentsDesc: Record mortgage payments here. They are excluded from the Transactions list and included in spending totals (e.g. Dashboard "Spent w/o Mortgage" excludes them).
mortgage.addMortgagePaymentDesc: Enter the payment date and amount.
mortgage.noPaymentsYet: No mortgage payments recorded yet. Add one above.
mortgage.removePaymentDesc: Remove {{date}} payment of {{amount}}? This cannot be undone.

import.title: Data
import.subtitle: Import and export your data.
import.uploadStatementDesc: Select a card or "Exported Data (PDF)", then choose a CSV file (Amex, Apple) or a previously downloaded export PDF. CSV imports skip transactions that already exist (same date and amount). Exported data imports skip by ID. After reviewing the preview, click "Add to transactions" or "Add all" to save—they persist across refreshes and appear on the Transactions and Income pages.
import.previewDescPdf: Transactions and income with existing IDs are omitted. Click "Add all" to add the rest.
import.previewDescCsv: Transactions matching existing entries (same date and amount) are skipped. Edit category per row if needed, then click "Add to transactions".
import.missingMetaDesc: This import includes categories/owners not in your settings.
import.exportStringDesc: Paste the exported data string (starts with BUDGET_TOOL_DATA_START or V2).
import.jsonImportDesc: Import a JSON export file created by this app.
import.exportDesc: Download your data as PDF, JSON, or an export string.

presetTransactions.title: Preset Transactions
presetTransactions.description: Templates for quick-fill when adding transactions.
presetTransactions.empty: No presets yet. Add one to quick-fill when adding transactions.
presetTransactions.emptyNoCategories: Add at least one expense category in Settings to create presets.
presetTransactions.deletePresetDesc: This preset will be removed. This cannot be undone.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Google Sheets sync, expense and income categories, and data.
settings.googleSheetsDesc: Connect your Google account and sync expenses, income, and totals to a spreadsheet.
settings.repairCorruptedDatesTitle: Fix dates that were corrupted (e.g. from Google Sheets formatting)
settings.syncConfirmDesc: This will overwrite your spreadsheet with the app's current expenses, income, and totals. Your sheet data will be replaced. This cannot be undone.
settings.restoreConfirmDesc: This will load data from the spreadsheet into the app and merge with existing transactions and income. Any matching rows will be skipped; new rows from the sheet will be added.
settings.restoreSyncNote: Restore from Sheet: load data from the spreadsheet into the app (e.g. after clearing local storage). Sync to Google Sheets: pull then push so app and sheet stay in sync.
settings.cardSourcesDesc: Enable or disable card sources. Only enabled sources appear in the transaction table and import.
settings.cardSourcesOneRequired: At least one source must be enabled.
settings.expenseCategoriesDesc: Comma-separated list. Used in dropdowns and presets.
settings.expenseCategoriesUncategorizedHint: Removing a category sets affected transactions to uncategorized.
settings.removeExpenseCategoryConfirmDesc: Removing "{{category}}" will set affected transactions to uncategorized.
settings.removeIncomeCategoryConfirmDesc: Removing "{{category}}" will set affected income entries to uncategorized.
settings.incomeCategoriesUncategorizedHint: Removing a category sets affected income entries to uncategorized.
settings.ownersNoOwnerHint: Removing an owner sets affected entries to No Owner.
settings.removeOwnerConfirmDesc: This will set any entries owned by {{owner}} to No Owner.
settings.deleteAllDataConfirmDesc: This will permanently remove all expenses, income, debts and preset transactions from this device. This cannot be undone. The page will reload.

addTransaction.dialogDesc: One row per transaction. Copy a row to duplicate, then edit. Rows with a valid amount are added on submit.

auth.notSignedInOrNoSpreadsheet: Not signed in or no spreadsheet set.
auth.signInToContinue: Sign in with Google to view your dashboard.
auth.createAccountSubheading: Sign in with Google to track expenses, income, and budgets in one place.
auth.signInDisclaimer: By signing in, you can sync your data with Google Sheets and access your dashboard from any device.
auth.valuePropSubtitle: Sync with Google Sheets. No credit card needed.

dashboard.introContent: View spending, income, and savings by month. Use the steps below to find key areas.
dashboard.monthSelectorContent: Pick which month to view. The dashboard shows totals and breakdowns for the selected month.
dashboard.summaryContent: Summary cards show total earned, spent, and saved for the selected month.
dashboard.overviewContent: Charts and breakdowns for earned vs spent, spending by type, and income by category.
dashboard.debtContent: Remaining debt balance and total paid off. Go to the Debt page to add or manage debts.
dashboard.byMonthContent: Monthly breakdown of earned vs spent across all months.

transactions.introContent: Browse, filter, and edit expense transactions. Use the toolbar to filter or add new entries.
transactions.toolbarContent: Filter by month, source, category, or search. Add a transaction or sync to Google Sheets if connected.
transactions.expensesListContent: Tap a row to edit category or delete. Select multiple to delete in bulk.

import.introContent: Import transactions from CSV or PDF. Choose a source, upload a file, then add to transactions.
import.uploadCardContent: Select Amex, Apple Card, Chase, or exported PDF. Choose a file to preview.
import.previewCardContent: Review expenses and income before adding. Duplicates (same date and amount) are skipped.

income.introContent: Track paychecks, rent, and other income. Add entries and edit or delete below.
income.addIncomeContent: Add a new income entry with date, amount, description, and category.
income.incomeListContent: Edit or delete income entries. Recurring income can be set for paychecks or rent.

debt.introContent: Track loans and debt payments. Add a debt, then record payments to see the balance go down.
debt.addDebtContent: Add a new debt with name and initial amount. You can set recurring payments later.
debt.debtListContent: View balance and payment history. Make payments or edit recurring from each debt.

mortgage.introContent: Record mortgage payments. They are excluded from the Transactions list but included in spending totals.
mortgage.addPaymentContent: Record a mortgage payment with date and amount.
mortgage.paymentsListContent: View all mortgage payments. Remove a payment if entered by mistake.

settings.introContent: Connect Google Sheets, manage expense and income categories, and delete all data if needed.
settings.googleSheetsContent: Connect your account and set a spreadsheet ID to sync or restore data.
settings.categoriesContent: Edit expense and income categories. They appear in dropdowns and presets.
settings.deleteAllContent: Permanently remove all expenses, income, debts, and presets from this device.

landing.heroTagline: Track expenses, income, and budgets in one place.
landing.valueProp: Import from Amex, Apple Card, and Chase. Categorize spending, sync with Google Sheets, and view your dashboard by month.
landing.featureImportDesc: Import from CSV or export to PDF, JSON, or string.
landing.featureRulesDesc: Create reusable transaction templates for quick-fill.
landing.featureSheetsDesc: Push and pull data to a spreadsheet.
landing.featurePdfDesc: Export transactions and income to PDF.
